axes_source: Read from data/brands/fly-io.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FF007A and the canvas #0A0A0F; contrast from the ink #F5F5F0 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FF007A; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 150ms, 8000ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #FF007A reaches 5.20:1 on the canvas #0A0A0F, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
